title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Raspberry Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Raspberry Edition Pre Filled Pods bring a juicy, tart mix of berry flavours to the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod blends Raspberry and Watermelon for a light, tangy-sweet vape, while the other deepens the flavour with Blueberry Raspberry - smooth, fruity and balanced. Each 2ml pod includes a 5ml refill reservoir, automatically topped up through the Dual 10K refill mechanism. A great pick for vapers who enjoy layered fruit vapes with clean intensity. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
